name: rental-synthetic
description: 20-scenario synthetic rental underwriting benchmark from the PRD's rental acquisition worked example (prd/14-evaluation.md / prd/17): scenarios with ground-truth outcomes (deal cash-flow at target rate, lease standing) plus synthetic variations injecting zoning changes, tax changes, and market shifts. Seed data lives in benchmarks/data/rental-synthetic/ (scenario-01..scenario-20.jsonl). Safety is scored by the adversarial-safety benchmark, not here — rental scenarios carry no guardrail events.
